thread:
Diego Rivera: Heads up — finishing RCA for last night's incident. Need decision on external comms wording and who owns the customer summary.
Carla Mendez: I can draft the public blurb. Prefer concise plain language, no internal jargon.
Ben Park: +1. Also we should include a timeline for the permanent fix and an owner. Customers ask for ETA.
Alice Chen: Quick note — some customers asked about data loss. We should confirm that explicitly.
Diego Rivera: Proposed internal draft: "Service disruption affecting inference (02:15–03:00 UTC). Root cause: autoscaler bug in burst path."
Alice Chen: Suggest softer public phrasing: "unexpected capacity issue in our autoscaling subsystem" — avoid 'bug'.
Carla Mendez: Agreed. Also need to decide RCA sharing policy: publish full RCA or provide detailed RCA on request?
Ben Park: Current stance: publish a customer-facing summary on status page. Offer detailed RCA to affected customers on request (and under contract/NDA if it contains sensitive info).
Diego Rivera: Looping in legal: @Eli (Legal) — can you confirm that's fine?
Eli (Legal): Confirmed. Public summary + on-request detailed RCA is our default. Redact logs/hostnames and exclude internal SRE runbooks from any external share.
Carla Mendez: Draft statuspage blurb (first pass):
```
We experienced a capacity disruption affecting inference requests from 02:15–03:00 UTC. The issue was mitigated and service restored. Our engineers are implementing a permanent fix. If you were affected, support will reach out with next steps.
```
Ben Park: Add a reassurance line: "No customer data loss occurred; stored models and data were unaffected."
Alice Chen: Good. Also include an FAQ line: "How can I get more details? Contact support@redwood.ai or request a detailed RCA."
Diego Rivera: Action items — Carla: finalize statuspage blurb (due in 2h). Ben: draft customer email template (48h). Alice: assemble impacted-customer list and severity (due 4h). Diego: coordinate with legal/PM and file RCA access decision.
Carla Mendez: I'll also include a short "what we did" bullet and avoid technical stack traces. Draft will be posted to #statuspage-drafts.
Eli (Legal): One more: redact any IPs, hostnames, and stack traces. If a customer requests logs, route through support with a data-sharing checklist.
Diego Rivera: Noted. Also we should tag this in the postmortem tracker as a possible recurring pattern: autoscale-flap. Assign remediation owner for recurring incidents.
Carla Mendez: Added action items to the tracker: https://tracker/INC-4321 — remediation owner set to @Ben Park.

Carla Mendez: Closing loop: owners assigned, timelines in tracker, statuspage live.
Ben Park: Filing a recurring-incident check for infra: will run regression tests on autoscale logic this week.
Eli (Legal): If any customer asks for the detailed RCA publicly, route to Legal + Security before publishing.
Diego Rivera: OK — end state: status page up, outreach templates in progress, tracker updated, policy confirmed. Good work. :thumbsup:
Carla Mendez: I'll post a short summary in #all-hands tomorrow morning so product and support are aligned.
